== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Galen's Lightsaber (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-63-Galens_Lightsaber.png]]) shows the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-64-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-galenslightsaber-pre.gif]]) show PC-E2.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Galen. While Galen defending a battle, his and Black Leader's immunity to atttition is +2. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. If total destiny > defense value, target hit, power -3, and may not be used to satisfy attrition.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1240_64</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
